Israel says strike killed Hamas finance chief; two others dead

Israel stated that an airstrike in Gaza killed Hamas finance chief Muhammad Abu Alwan. The strike also resulted in the deaths of two other individuals. The information was attributed to Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu.
